name: U.S.S. Enterprise-C, Time-Tossed
oracle_text:
When U.S.S. Enterprise-C enters or dies, you may discard your hand. If you do, draw a card for each card discarded this way.
Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 3+.)
3+ | Flying
blocked_sentences: Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Spacecraft. Station only as a sorcery. It's an artifact creature at 3+.)

needs.what: Station symbols (721) on a keyword (3+ Flying), plus the Spacecraft rule that the permanent is an artifact creature with its printed P/T (6/6) only at its highest station threshold (3+ charge counters) and a noncreature artifact below it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Ability.threshold is accepted only on activated abilities (loader _compile_threshold raises for any other kind, and keywords are card-level with no gate at all); a static `condition` on counters_on would leave a granted keyword on the permanent rather than gating a printed striation, which the packet notes forbid; and nothing gates the Spacecraft becoming a 6/6 artifact creature at 3+ -- a counters-conditioned animate/type static would approximate rule 721 rather than implement station. The Station activation itself (tap_permanents with `as` + add_counters power_of) and the enters-or-dies discard-hand/draw trigger are expressible, but the card is only partly expressible
